selection: 20 task-relevant contributions to the ATS redesign. Editorial selection, not a global ranking. Scores are metadata. One primary skill per phase.

skills.name: superfast
skills.principle: Measure total effort to acceptance.
skills.application: Stop adding rounds after the contract is satisfied.
skills.guard: Compare speed only at equal acceptance.

skills.name: aiworkflow
skills.principle: Define outcome and executable acceptance before tool choice.
skills.application: Use one CLI core with explicit commands.
skills.guard: verify runs the supplied check without rewriting it.

skills.name: zeroloop
skills.principle: Use the narrow affected check; stop after green.
skills.application: just check bundles types and behavior tests.
skills.guard: Do not repeat an unchanged green check for reassurance.

skills.name: warm-handoff
skills.principle: Use fewer requests on smaller context at real boundaries.
skills.application: Keep long logs in files and return evidence paths.
skills.guard: No periodic keepalive or forced restart.

skills.name: synapse-recall
skills.principle: Load prior decisions only when they change the next action.
skills.application: Review existing benchmark evidence before rerunning it.
skills.guard: Bind changing claims to dated sources.

skills.name: agent-efficiency-orchestrator
skills.principle: Optimize accepted work per total effort.
skills.application: Reject saving claims when acceptance fails.
skills.guard: Report cost separately from time and quality.

skills.name: superiss
skills.principle: Bind ownership, source and executable acceptance.
skills.application: Use an explicit project database; create no second task board.
skills.guard: An ATS result is not a native SIS proof.

skills.name: best-defaults
skills.principle: Choose a small reversible default with an override.
skills.application: Installation shows a plan; --apply writes.
skills.guard: A project update does not authorize unrelated host changes.

skills.name: antislop
skills.principle: Make each judgment a checkable statement.
skills.application: Lead the evidence story with a counterexample.
skills.guard: Use slopcheck and an editorial deletion pass.

skills.name: thinkforward
skills.principle: Look for the bottleneck and a way to falsify the claim.
skills.application: Test whether a shorter view loses a needed failure signal.
skills.guard: Check exits and raw evidence; expose omissions.

skills.name: speedplaybook
skills.principle: Identify the cost class before optimizing.
skills.application: Measure cache cost separately from process time and output size.
skills.guard: Do not transfer a speed factor between workloads.

skills.name: loop2goal
skills.principle: Choose the next step by its contribution to acceptance.
skills.application: verify writes evidence for exactly one execution.
skills.guard: The result points back to its raw evidence.

skills.name: skill-portfolio-governance
skills.principle: Review overlap and observed behavior before retirement.
skills.application: Curate 20 contributions without loading 20 workflows.
skills.guard: Atlas score is not quality or a general ranking.

skills.name: verify-and-stop
skills.principle: Distinguish pass, fail, unavailable and blocked.
skills.application: Startup failure is 127; timeout is 124.
skills.guard: After correction, repeat only affected failed checks.

skills.name: researchflow
skills.principle: Preserve sources and derive checkable findings.
skills.application: Keep source hashes and relative benchmark links.
skills.guard: Separate measurements, estimates and proposals.

skills.name: autom
skills.principle: Evaluate one bounded candidate and keep or reject it.
skills.application: New defaults need repeated comparisons with fixed acceptance.
skills.guard: No automatic self-editing or paid model calls.

skills.name: context-budget
skills.principle: Account for loaded rules, skills and tool definitions.
skills.application: Keep a permanent broad tool registry out of the core.
skills.guard: Tokens-per-tool heuristics are not billing evidence.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.principle: Find the cause from diagnostics and reproduction.
skills.application: Preserve complete stdout and stderr before shortening.
skills.guard: Empty or unusual diagnostics cannot turn a failure green.

skills.name: ratiomaster
skills.principle: Measure user effort alongside actual success.
skills.application: Provide a direct result, an install plan and a recovery path.
skills.guard: CLI time is not browser or customer UX evidence.

skills.name: ponytail
skills.principle: Prefer existing paths and the standard library.
skills.application: Use Bun and Node built-ins; no runtime packages.
skills.guard: No provider gateway, cron jobs or generic plugin framework.
